These synthetic databases come from MaxMind's MaxMind-DB test-data directory:
https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/0ee49278e35fd7bdf341ac236edbba20de1aceb9/test-data

They are distributed under the accompanying Apache 2.0 license. They contain
test records rather than production geolocation data. The addresses 192.0.2.1
and 2001:db8::1 are absent and exercise AddressNotFoundException.
